slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: “虞皇亲笔诏书，迎六皇子孟尘回京！”
“择吉日，与镇国王府黎清月完婚，不得拒绝！”
大虞皇朝，北域。
一辆古色古香的马车上，坐着一位少年。
他，孟尘，大虞皇朝六皇子，九岁那年便被送入敌国为质子，如今十七岁。
随着大虞皇朝日渐鼎盛，两国谈和。
三月前，一纸诏书飘来，迎其回京。
皇帝下令，宣告天下，要将老镇国王的孙女黎清月，赐婚于六皇子，命其归京之后择吉日大婚！
得知此消息，皇朝一片震惊。
镇国王是谁？
那可是战功累累，曾屠魔杀敌百万，打出赫赫威名的黎战神啊！
被先皇封为镇国王！
虽然镇国王老了，但他的孙女黎清月，却生的倾国倾城，不仅没有弱了镇国王府的威名，如今更是被誉为大虞第一女战神！
黎清月与孟尘。
他们两个，一个是手握兵权的女战神。
一个是手无缚鸡之力，当了八年质子，毫无地位可言的废皇子。
谁也想不到，虞皇会将黎清月赐婚给一个废皇子。
有人猜测，虞皇内心愧疚，想要弥补这八年来的亏欠，有意借此婚约，扶六皇子上位。
所以，很多人都不想让六皇子活着回京。
当然，也有人猜测。
虞皇并非是扶持六皇子，而是故意借此机会，打压镇国王府的势力，以此削权。
同时，也可断绝其他皇子想要求娶黎清月，来壮大自身势力的目的。
这，便是虞皇的权衡之术。
不管虞皇的心思究竟如何，对于各方势力来说，只要归京的路上截杀掉六皇子，这联姻便不复存在。
“殿下，根据密信消息，大虞境内有埋伏！”
“此次归京，怕是危机四伏。”
车厢内，一个灰衣老仆，身躯虽枯萎，但眸光却锐利，凝声开口。
他身后，背着一把被布包裹的长剑，形成鲜明对比。
话落间。
一行车马缓缓进入大虞境内，老者神情都严肃了几分。
“八年了，自然有人不希望我活着回去。”
“不过，究其缘由，还是赐婚之事动了各方利益，若无此事，我一个质子归京，倒不至于被人暗中截杀。”
孟尘看着窗外景色，又看了一眼老者，将一杯茶送到了他的身前，平静道：“这黎清月虽是女战神，背后靠着镇国王府，但却也是一个烫手山芋啊。”
背剑老者闻言点头，认真道：“殿下八年未归，又摊上这么一个烫手山芋，归京后怕是处境艰难。”
“既如此，老奴去杀了她。”
孟尘摆手：“那倒不必。”
“剑老，先解决路上的敌人，该来了！”
话落，孟尘抬眸。
他清澈的双眸闪烁微光，一道道机械般的数据显化在眼前，分别指向不同的坐标与方位。
哪怕隔着车厢，依然感应到了数千米外潜伏的众多杀手。
包括他们的性别，年龄，修为境界，气血等等，全都看的一清二楚。
对此。
孟尘很平静，显然这般袭杀，他见过不止一次了。
content_en:
"Emperor Yu personally wrote an edict to welcome the Sixth Prince Meng Chen back to the capital!"
"Choose an auspicious day to get married to Li Qingyue, the king of the town. Don't refuse!"
…
Dayu Dynasty, Northern Territory.
There was a young man sitting on an antique carriage.
He, Meng Chen, was the sixth prince of the Dayu Dynasty. He was sent to the enemy country as a hostage when he was nine years old. He is now seventeen years old.
As the Yu Dynasty became more and more prosperous, the two countries negotiated peace.
Three months ago, a piece of edict came to welcome him back to Beijing.
The emperor issued an order to announce to the world that Li Qingyue, the granddaughter of the king of Laozhen, would be given in marriage to the sixth prince, and ordered to choose an auspicious day for the wedding after returning to the capital!
Upon hearing the news, the imperial court was shocked.
Who is the town king?
That was the Li War God who had numerous military exploits, had slaughtered demons and killed millions of enemies, and fought with great fame!
He was named the king of the town by the late emperor!
Although the King of Zhen is getting old, his granddaughter Li Qingyue has given birth to a beautiful woman. Not only has the reputation of the King of Zhen not weakened, but she is now known as the first female war goddess in Dayu!
Li Qingyue and Meng Chen.
Of the two of them, one is the female war goddess who holds military power.
One is a deposed prince who has no power to restrain a chicken, has been a hostage for eight years, and has no status at all.
No one could have imagined that Emperor Yu would marry Li Qingyue to a deposed prince.
Some people speculate that Emperor Yu felt guilty and wanted to make up for the debts he had incurred over the past eight years, so he intended to use this engagement to help the sixth prince ascend to the throne.
Therefore, many people did not want the Sixth Prince to return to Beijing alive.
Of course, there are also speculations.
Emperor Yu was not supporting the Sixth Prince, but deliberately taking this opportunity to suppress the forces that suppressed the King's Palace, thereby reducing his power.
At the same time, it can also prevent other princes from asking to marry Li Qingyue to strengthen their own power.
This is Emperor Yu's balancing act.
No matter what Emperor Yu's thoughts were, for all the forces, as long as the sixth prince was intercepted and killed on the way back to the capital, the marriage would cease to exist.
"Your Highness, according to the secret message, there is an ambush in Dayu!"
"My return to Beijing this time may be full of dangers."
In the carriage, an old servant in gray clothes, with a withered body but sharp eyes, spoke in a solemn voice.
Behind him, he carried a long sword wrapped in cloth, which formed a sharp contrast.
The words fell.
A group of carriages and horses slowly entered the territory of Dayu, and the old man looked a little serious.
"It's been eight years. Of course some people don't want me to come back alive."
"However, the reason is that the marriage grant has affected the interests of all parties. If it had not happened, I would not have been secretly intercepted and killed when I returned to Beijing as a hostage."
Meng Chen looked at the scenery outside the window, glanced at the old man again, brought a cup of tea to him, and said calmly: "Although Li Qingyue is the goddess of war and has the King's Palace behind her, she is also a hot potato."
The old man carrying the sword nodded when he heard the words and said seriously: "His Highness has not returned for eight years, and he is faced with such a hot potato. I am afraid that he will be in a difficult situation after returning to the capital."
"In that case, old slave, go and kill her."
Meng Chen waved his hand: "That's not necessary."
"Jian Lao, deal with the enemies on the road first, it's time to come!"
After finishing his words, Meng Chen raised his eyes.
His clear eyes flickered, and mechanical data appeared in front of him, pointing to different coordinates and directions.
Even across the carriage, he could still sense the many killers lurking thousands of meters away.
Including their gender, age, cultivation level, Qi and blood, etc., everything can be seen clearly.
To this.
Meng Chen was very calm. It was obvious that he had seen such an attack more than once.
